 Top 5 of 2025: #1: Howard Marks Dec 29, 2025

 We’re counting down the top 5 episodes of 2025. Coming in at #1
is the legend, Howard Marks from Oaktree. I waited a while to have
Howard on the show to capture a moment where one of his Memos
particularly caught my eye. That happened when he wrote 'Gimme
Credit' earlier this year. We dive into his thoughts on the
implications of the growth of private credit for investors.

 

With that, I hope you sprint to the finish line of this year
with all the gusto in your soul, and come out on the
other side of the ball drop with renewed excitement,
aspirations, and energy for the year ahead.

 About the Podcast 
 
 
 Allocator and asset management expert, Ted Seides, conducts in-depth interviews with leaders in the institutional investing industry. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors. Learn more and join our community at capitalallocators.com.
